Bearish ordinary candidate is mirrored from reference, not double-mirrored.

supplemental_items.interpretation: Track strict directional confirmation-side extreme before First, equality retains existing fixed source. Mode A First at boundary allowed; candidate First index is loop position while box source indices come from Candle.index. Frozen boundary from original start. supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of mutation, data flow, cursor lifetime, cache, ordered guard or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: After First, strictly update opposite edge (source index is loop position, display from current candle), then strict confirmation; Break also loop position, refine and return. No owner-boundary invalidation. Normal exhaustion optionally saves next=end+1 with candidate reference; early returns do not save a new cursor.

findings.description: Clarify cursor handling, dispatch order and reflected reference versus native bearish result.
findings.resolution: Without retain flag ignore supplied cursor; check exact bullish trend then exact bearish trend, else directional detect first_only, clone first or null. Retaining ordinary bearish route scans reflected reference then mirrors candidate once; cursor type assertions depend on native assertion configuration.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic recheck remain pending.

findings.description: Distinguish positional versus source indices, save-by-reference and early-return cursor behavior.
findings.resolution: After candidate update opposite edge strictly; First, improved opposite source and Break use loop positions, whereas initial box source indices come from Candle.index. Strict directional confirmation sets Break and refines, returns without saving a new cursor. Only normal exhaustion with retention saves next=end+1,fixed source,candidate reference; null. Empty window returns before cursor save.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic recheck remain pending.
